rv.q: This production of Good People from 4 Chairs Theatre is simultaneously heavy and touching thanks to the sharp writing, strong acting, and powerful direction that shines a hard light on the economic struggles many families face.
4 Chairs Theatre’s production of David Lindsay-Abaire’s GOOD PEOPLE is a thoroughly enjoyable, must-see comic drama.
Good People by David Lindsay-Abaire is highly recommended.
Jodi Kingsley and Bryan Breau are fantastic.
Lindsay-Abaire’s story offers keen insights into how a lifetime on an economic and emotional knife-edge leaves soul-deep scars.
It's a humorous and poignant story of very real people, caught in an all-too-common financial quagmire.
I promise you willlearn a great deal about life and have a few laughs as well.
4 Chairs Theatre embraces those complexities with compassion and sincerity, delivering a thoughtful, emotionally resonant production well worth seeing.

cn.t: Lindsay-Abaire's sharp exploration of class divide and socioeconomic struggle resonates in this engaging, well-acted revival that balances humor with brutal honesty about poverty and luck.
